SRC-228:R001.text: Trace operator input, carrier validation, decision scope, SAIOPS commit, state/next_action projection, binding brake, router admission, restart and reconcile; identify affected symbols and root cause.

SRC-228:R002.text: Reuse existing operator authority and source/journal mechanisms; do not add an independent approval override or parallel authorization subsystem.

SRC-228:R003.text: Separate canonical operation provenance, authenticated operator-input provenance, exact decision authorization and persistence; bind integrity-checked approval to content, project identity and gate identity.

SRC-228:R004.text: Missing or unverifiable operator input must refuse authorization; model-supplied text or a digest generated by the engine cannot authenticate itself.

SRC-228:R005.text: One authoritative journaled transition validates witness and scope, records the accepted limitation, resolves only its matching WAIT, projects the next action and commits consistent state.

SRC-228:R006.text: A valid scoped decision persists through restart/resume/reconcile without half-committed contradiction or resurrection; natural-language mentions never satisfy a gate.

SRC-228:R007.text: Historical SAITULS E-3009 remains canonical but operator-authority-unverified; preserve its gate pending independent new approval or genuine historical witness; never start/close T-285/T-286 or dispatch the 13 held tickets.

SRC-228:R008.text: Deterministic disposable fixtures include the historical E-3003 -> E-3009 -> E-3010 -> E-3011 shape and exercise real binding_brake and router admission.

SRC-228:R009.text: A valid authenticated decision resolves exactly its matching gate.

SRC-228:R010.text: Missing operator carrier and incorrect digest do not authorize a decision.

SRC-228:R011.text: Model-supplied approval and canonical ticket_move without operator witness grant no gate authority.

SRC-228:R012.text: Valid scoped approval survives restart and reconciliation cannot recreate its discharged WAIT.
